main.description: An emoji reaction. Written by the reacting person. Unlike a recommend, someone can leave several reactions on the same subject, one per emoji. A like is a reaction with ❤️. The subject can be any record, not only a post.

subject.description: What is being reacted to: usually a community.lexicon.thread.post or .thread, but any record works.

cid.description: Optional CID of the subject, pinning the reaction to one version of it.
